Subject: Mutual action plan & signature sequencing for StellarSys (MSA / DPA / Order Form)

Hi Tom & Alexa —

Thanks again for the productive demo yesterday. Per our conversation, I attached a starter mutual action plan (MAP-draft-v1.xlsx) that lays out what we expect across evaluation, security evidence, and final contracting. High level ask: can you review the milestones and confirm who on your side is the procurement/contract owner for each item?

Proposed milestones in the sheet:
- Evaluation window (pilot) start: Aug 4 — 4 weeks
- Security questionnaire / SOC2 exchange: concurrent with pilot week 1–2
- Legal review (MSA redline) week 3–4
- Order form (products/pricing) finalization: week 4
- Signature window / cutover: week 5

Two sequencing questions we want to lock down:
1) Is StellarSys comfortable signing the MSA + DPA ahead of the order form, or do you need a signed order form (or PO) before counter-signature?
2) Any mandatory procurement dates or budget approvals we should map into the plan?

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (starter), OrderForm-template.pdf

I'll loop Karthik for the redline guidance and Laura for delivery timeline. If it helps, we can set a 30‑minute alignment call next week to agree the MAP and sign sequence.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & signature sequencing for StellarSys (MSA / DPA / Order Form)

Chloe / Tom —

Thanks for the MAP, Chloe. I reviewed the starter and added comments in MSA-redline-annotated.docx (attached). A few notes from legal that will determine sequencing:
- Data residency / sub-processing (clause 5.2): if StellarSys requires a specific data-residency commitment or an auditor access clause, we may need to push the DPA sign-off earlier.
- SOC2 evidence: sharing SOC2 snapshot and control matrix (we can supply SOC2-cert.pdf). If that is sufficient, legal review should be able to proceed in parallel to procurement pricing.
- Order of signing: our default preference is MSA + DPA executed prior to any invoice-triggering order form. We can be flexible for enterprise customers who require a PO first — in that case we usually include a short-term pilot addendum that allows work to start while we finish signature sequencing.

Action items for Tom / Alexa: please confirm if StellarSys requires an executed PO/order form before counter-signature, or whether procurement can accept an MSA+DPA route with an attached order form to be executed after.

I attached: MSA-redline-annotated.docx, SOC2-cert.pdf

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@stellarsys.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alexa Castillo <alexa@stellarsys.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & signature sequencing for StellarSys (MSA / DPA / Order Form)

Karthik — thanks for the quick review and the redlines. A couple of clarifications from procurement here at StellarSys: 

- Procurement policy: for new vendors we require an executed order form or PO before finance will release any funds. That said, we can sign an MSA+DPA in advance if the order form is marked as "pending pricing finalization" and there is an explicit pilot scope so the PO can follow immediately after pilot acceptance.
- Data residency: our security lead confirms we do not need a hard geographic residency guarantee for pilot data, but will expect it for production. We'll need the DPA to allow for that future constraint (i.e., add a production-specific addendum).

Proposed sequencing (from StellarSys):
1) Sign MSA + DPA (allow pilot to start)
2) Pilot (4 weeks) — acceptance triggers order form finalization
3) Issue PO / execute order form (finance)
4) Move to production and finalize residency addendum

We're comfortable with the pilot addendum approach you mentioned. Can you confirm Redwood can accept the PO after pilot acceptance and that work completed during pilot will be billable by order form? We'll need that to justify the PO.

Tom
Tom Reynolds
Director, Procurement | StellarSys
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@stellarsys.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & signature sequencing for StellarSys (MSA / DPA / Order Form)

Tom — really appreciate the clarity. Yes, Redwood can run the pilot under an MSA + DPA (pilot addendum) and accept a PO/order form after acceptance. A couple of practical items so procurement/finance have what they need: 

- We'll add a 1-paragraph pilot addendum that explicitly states "pilot fees to be invoiced upon order form execution" and that work during pilot is governed by the MSA/DPA but invoicing is tied to the final order form. That gives your finance policy the paper trail they require.
- Laura will pull together a concise order form (OrderForm-template.pdf) with pilot pricing and acceptance criteria and we can include that as an appendix to the MSA+DPA.

Proposed timeline (we can adjust based on your budget calendar):
- Jul 30: Redwood sends updated MAP + pilot addendum (Chloe / Karthik)
- Aug 4: Pilot kickoff (4 weeks)
- Aug 29: Pilot acceptance meeting
- Sep 1: StellarSys issues PO / executes order form
- Sep 5: Production onboarding (if PO executed)

I'll update the MAP and send a short 30-minute sync invite for Tue Aug 29 (pilot acceptance).

Best,
Chloe
